::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/applicable_plans"}
#docs
The per-product `applicable_plans` read for the whole catalog in one call — one entry per add-on or charge product, each naming its `item`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.item` | `string` | The attached add-on or charge product |
| `data.applies_to_all` | `boolean` | True if the addon can attach to every plan. |
| `data.plans` | `array of string` | The ids of the plans the addon can attach to (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `data.applicability` | `object` | How each plan treats the addon. |
| `data.config` | `object` | Per-plan settings for the addon, keyed by plan id. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of applicable_plans objects |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/applicable_plans" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "applicable_plans",
      "item": "si_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
      "applies_to_all": false,
      "plans": [
        "pro-monthly-usd"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
::
